subject: Fix typo in valkey-cli.c (#979)
reason: The change only corrects a typo in a log message string ("replicsa" -> "replicas") printed by valkey-cli's clusterManagerOptimizeAntiAffinity warning. No control flow, command behavior, reply, exit status, or data path changes; it is a cosmetic text fix with no behavior to regress, so no scenario is needed.
